description: WHO holds or runs for WHAT — turn a candidate/officeholder name into their seat + next race. Given a name (full, last-name, or a registry alias — "Lauren Boebert", "Boebert"), returns the person(s) who match with their…

cycle.description: Optional — keep only matches whose next_race is in this cycle (e.g. 2026).

limit.description: Max people to return when a name is ambiguous (default 8).

name.description: A candidate or officeholder name — full ("Lauren Boebert"), last-name ("Boebert"), or any registry alias. Matching folds free-typed names onto the canonical person.

office.description: Optional — keep only matches whose current OR next-race office matches (house, senate, governor, state_senate, state_assembly, …); the "us_" prefix is optional ("house" == "us_house").

party.description: Optional — keep only matches of this party (D/R/I), normalized by leading letter. For a stage/party-scoped picker.

workspace_scope.description: Optional workspace for THIS call: use an exact personal/team ID from list_workspaces. Repeat on each call; it does not change the connection default. Must agree with MCP metadata and the effective HTTP workspace selector (header, otherwise connector URL). OAuth connections can only use their granted workspace. Membership and campaign permissions still apply.

name: resolve_candidate
